knownLimitations.impact: All 87 API endpoints are accessible without authentication
knownLimitations.remediation: Add JWT authentication middleware to all /api/* routes

knownLimitations.limitation: No rate limiting on API endpoints
knownLimitations.impact: API vulnerable to abuse and DoS attacks
State-changing API calls vulnerable to CSRF attacks
Missing X-Frame-Options, CSP, HSTS headers on API responses

knownLimitations.limitation: No malicious file scanning for evidence uploads
knownLimitations.impact: Uploaded files not checked for malware

knownLimitations.limitation: No evidence file hash verification on retrieval
knownLimitations.impact: Cannot detect file tampering after upload
knownLimitations.remediation: Add SHA-256 hash storage and verification

knownLimitations.impact: Queue state lost on server restart
Difficult to aggregate and search logs in production
knownLimitations.remediation: Enable Fastify's pino logger with JSON output

knownLimitations.limitation: Vision and speech analysis use simulated models
knownLimitations.impact: Forensic reconstruction generates realistic but simulated data
knownLimitations.remediation: Integrate production ML models (TensorFlow, Whisper, etc.)

knownLimitations.limitation: No PDF export for compliance reports
knownLimitations.impact: Attorneys cannot download formatted PDF reports
knownLimitations.remediation: Add PDF generation library (puppeteer or react-pdf)

conditions: Add rate limiting to all API endpoints
